name: @unum-pillars/uikit
description: A port of UIkit 3 to use for our stuff: one themed build, shared by every app.

scripts.css: mkdir -p dist/css && lessc --include-path=node_modules:node_modules/uikit/src/less/components src/theme.less dist/css/uikit.css && esbuild dist/css/uikit.css --minify --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/css/uikit.min.css
scripts.build: npm run css && npm run js
